BrochureContent.Content:
Beautifully presented bungalows in walking distance of town are very rare to come to the market, we are very excited to present an excellent opportunity to acquire a detached bungalow with detached garage to rear, extending to approximately 915 sq. ft., ideally positioned in a highly sought-after and exceptionally convenient area of Milehouse, Enniscorthy, Co. Wexford.
Set on a private plot, fully walled in with iron gates, tarmac driveway and detached garage to rear, private lawns and mature boundary to rear. Ample room to extend. 

The property is currently vacant; this home offers superb potential for purchasers seeking a well-located property to modernise and enhance. Having been vacant for over two years, the property may qualify for the Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant, subject to eligibility and application requirements, presenting an attractive opportunity to further upgrade and personalise the home.
The accommodation is generously proportioned and comprises an entrance hall with laminate flooring, a bright sitting room featuring a solid-fuel stove with marble surround and back boiler heating new fresh carpeting, a kitchen/dining room fitted with solid oak units to waist and eyre level   oak units, lino floor and tiled backsplash with back hall access to rear. There are also three excellent-sized bedrooms, each benefiting from built-in wardrobes, as well as generous main bathroom consisting of shower cubicle with Triton electric shower unit, bathtub and wc/whb, tiled to wet areas. 
Additional features include uPVC double-glazed windows, solid-fuel central heating via the back boiler, a fantastic, detached garage, and ample off-street parking. The property’s private setting combines with its outstanding convenience, being within easy reach of Lidl, Aldi, service stations, bus stops, sporting facilities, schools and a wide range of local amenities.
This is a highly appealing home in a prime Enniscorthy location, offering comfortable existing accommodation together with significant scope to create a beautiful modern family home. 

Overall Size
c. 85 sq. m. approx. / 915 sq. ft. 

BER

Services
Mains water, mains drainage, mains electricity, back boiler heating


Location
Occupying a lovely private plot along Enniscorthy’s Milehouse Road, this property offers a nice quiet environment, walking distance to town via paths making it  very accessible to town and all associated amenities. Such amenities very nearby include Lidl/Aldi as well as 2 service stations in close proximity. The property is only a couple of minutes’ drive to the Motorway and to the centre of Enniscorthy town with a plethora of other amenities to include several schools, shops, cafes, restaurants, church, to name only a few.

Included Items
Washing machine, oven, solid fuel stove.
